title: Multilingual illustrated posters
slide_intent: Let language variety become visible in the composition because the service’s breadth should be understood before reading detailed copy.
strategic_value: Repeated foreign-language words and expressive figures can connect Duolingo’s language offer with an energetic visual identity.
demonstration: Two portrait posters place stacked multilingual words beside illustrated characters, one on blue and one on green; each ends in a branded footer.
practical_value: Compare how one poster structure accommodates different word lengths, colors and character poses.

content_islands.name: Blue poster
content_islands.spec: Stack the multilingual go words at left beside a running figure; retain the blue footer with signature and app badges.

content_islands.name: Green poster
content_islands.spec: Stack cheers translations beside the figure holding a glass; retain the white footer.

reference_purposes.Application: The two finished poster compositions show the identity applied to multilingual campaigns.
reference_purposes.Expression: Stacked words, colorful figures and alternating blue and green fields create a recognizable campaign family.
